title: Choose the new look for Nhako Tools
question: The roll assigned Laluan (Rapid KL wayfinding). Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. You will see home, a tool page and mobile in the chosen world before anything is built.

options.label: Laluan: every tool is a station
options.lineage: Rapid KL LRT/MRT wayfinding, bilingual station signage
options.thesis: The site reads like the rail map every KL student already navigates: each category is a coloured line, each tool a coded station, and your job travels a route from Drop to Save.
options.viewport: Dark signage header with the hammer and a search bar like the station directory; below, five coloured lines (PDF P, Image I, Media M, Kira K, Dev D) with the most-used stations as roundels: P05 Compress PDF to 500 KB, I07 Passport photo, K01 Kalkulator gaji.
options.risk: If the line metaphor is applied to every element it turns into a costume; it must stay in type, colour, codes and the progress route.

raised.raise: The number is the hero: file sizes before and after are set at display scale, hierarchy by scale contrast alone.
Before and after previews are registered at the same scale, so the saving is seen, not read.
State is a mark in a fixed cell with tabular figures: filled done, hollow pending, red struck failed.
Each category owns exactly one line colour everywhere, and grids reflow in whole cells.

options.label: Sayap: the national butterfly
options.lineage: Rajah Brooke’s birdwing (Trogonoptera brookiana), Malaysia’s national butterfly
options.thesis: Nhako’s butterflies become one real Malaysian butterfly: velvet black shell, emerald wing bands that fill as work completes, a crimson mark for the one thing to press.
options.viewport: Black top bar with the hammer and a wing-band underline; light work area; the drop zone framed by two emerald bands that open like wings when a file lands; popular jobs as clean cards beneath.
options.risk: Black plus one vivid green sits close to the familiar dark-with-neon look; it needs the light work area and the crimson to stay its own.

options.label: Gate board and boarding pass
options.lineage: KLIA departure boards and AirAsia boarding passes
options.thesis: Every result is issued as a boarding pass: from your file, to the output, size, time, gate. Home is a departures board of the jobs people are doing.
options.viewport: A departures board lists jobs (Compress PDF, under 500 KB, gate P5) with a search above; the result pass is the signature, segmented and scannable.
options.case: Holds product clarity (the pass is an excellent result receipt); loses on audience identification to the rail map students use daily.
options.risk: Travel framing can feel like a theme on tools that have nothing to do with travel.

options.label: Bitmap specimen
options.lineage: Emigre bitmap type, carried by Nhako’s own pixel hammer and butterflies
options.thesis: The pixel brand goes typographic: the job’s name set in proud pixel letters at poster scale, everything else in a fine grotesk.
options.viewport: A pixel headline ‘KECILKAN PDF / COMPRESS PDF’ over a clean search, pixel butterflies as the only ornament.
options.case: Holds audience identification (it is already Nhako’s pixel brand); loses on product clarity and premium feel next to Smallpdf.
options.risk: Reads retro or gamer rather than premium if the pixel type leaks into body text.

options.label: Variable type specimen
options.case: Loses both axes: students do not identify with a foundry specimen, and it says nothing about files.
options.kept: Hierarchy by scale contrast: the size number is the hero.

options.label: Botanical folio
options.case: Loses both axes: a quiet folio cannot carry a deadline job.
options.kept: Registration: before and after shown at the same scale.

options.label: Timetable slide rack
options.case: Loses both axes: the raked one-size grammar fights a phone-first task screen.
options.kept: State as a mark in a fixed cell, with tabular figures.

options.label: Character goods catalog
options.case: Loses both axes: cute cast-of-mascots framing undercuts trust with a file you are about to submit.
options.kept: One ribbon colour per category, whole-cell reflow.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What iLovePDF, Smallpdf and PDF24 ship, executed impeccably: white page, big tool grid, one bold Select files button.
canonCard.viewport: Headline, a grid of every tool as icon tiles, and a big red Select files button on each tool page.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competitors it has to beat.
